secondaryIdInfos.domain: FDA Office of Orphan Product Development

identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Sirolimus in LAM
identificationModule.officialTitle: Multicenter International Lymphangioleiomyomatosis Efficacy and Safety of Sirolimus Trial

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Unlabeled sirolimus tablets were provided by Pfizer. Identical appearing placebo tablets were obtained from a commercial source. Sirolimus levels were reported only to the medical monitor. To maintain the blind, when dose adjustments were made in the sirolimus group, a sham adjustment was also made in the placebo group

armGroups.label: Active Agent (Sirolimus)
armGroups.description: Participants receive sirolimus daily for 1 year and are followed with serial pulmonary function tests, 6-minute walk tests, and symptom and QOL questionnaires over a 2-year period.

armGroups.label: Placebo Arm
armGroups.description: Participants receive placebo daily for 1 year and followed with serial pulmonary function tests, 6-minute walk tests, and symptom and QOL questionnaires over a 2-year period.

interventions.name: Sirolimus
interventions.description: A sirolimus dose of 2 tablets (1 mg/tablet) per day for 1 year.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: A placebo dose of 2 tablets per day for 1 year.
